points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake C++17/MPI build and documented commands are committed; evaluator did not perform a clean rebuild because the host external symlink is dangling.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: README documents case/config/output CLI and source contains argument validation.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Functional but largely monolithic solver/src/main.cpp; tools/report.py and validation helper are separated.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Trust policy applied; no internal wrapper/executable call seen, but no external provenance investigation is performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: CGNS/config-driven case handling; no two-filename-only branches identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Source/report describe METIS owned/ghost partitioning, neighbor exchange, reductions and rank-local data; attempt evidence contains np=1/8 comparisons.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity fallback, finite checks and documented robust first-order predictor schedule.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Immutable attempt 297126a contains all eight validator-ready packages and reported Python/diff checks.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated result commit audit passed with 57 allowed source/report/figure paths and no prohibited paths.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report/source document compressible governing variables and nondimensional controls.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured mesh, adjacency and boundary families are implemented/documented.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Cell-centered conservative FV residual assembly is documented and present in source.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov numerical flux is explicit; diffusive but legitimate.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic treatments are documented with reported gates.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares linear reconstruction exists, but steady high-order sweep is only every 25th outer step.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Limiter/positivity controls are documented as production-active.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier treatment and tangential skin-friction reporting are described.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Local block-Jacobi implicit relaxation and CFL/local controls are described; not a coupled LU-SGS method.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Reported BDF2 dual-time loop reaches t=300 with frozen histories, target-miss and inner-iteration statistics in immutable result evidence.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS, halo exchange, reductions and np=1/8 evidence are reported.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All packages are preserved in immutable attempt 297126a and passed validator, but raw outputs are correctly excluded from curated result commit.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Official validator explicitly passed exact eight canonical directories plus report from immutable attempt 297126a.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Attempt metadata/report describe seven converged steady runs and Re200 statistically periodic at t=300.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Reported residual reductions, wall/positivity checks, forces and MPI comparisons are plausible; no independent rerun performed.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Curated report includes Mach, pressure, residual, force and surface/wake figures for every case.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Detailed LaTeX report states methods, controls, force tables, limitations and manifest traceability.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report identifies run/figure manifests and source CSV/field files, but raw evidence is intentionally outside curated submission.
